title: 两周前我把 OpenAI 的 Agent SDK 移植成了 Go，两周后我让它"叛变"了
content: The developer migrated OpenAI's Agent SDK to Go two weeks ago, then pivoted from a faithful Python port to an independent Go-native design. Key changes include tree-based conversation history (enabling branching/retry), checkpoint-based context compression instead of rewriting history, and mid-run user interruption support. Technical mishaps included accidentally committing 18MB and 8.6MB binaries to git history, and stale documentation links—prompting automated doc verification in CI. The project uses AI-assisted development with Claude Code for mechanical refactoring and adversarial review, plus a spec.md "constitution" governing behavioral decisions.

title: 菲尔兹奖得主预警：AI可能杀死数学
content: Fields Medalists warn that AI may "kill mathematics" not through scarcity but through excess. Jacob Tsimerman joined OpenAI to study AI safety, predicting AI will surpass human mathematicians within two years. Timothy Gowers fears mathematics could become an "abandoned graveyard" as AI-generated proofs proliferate exponentially while human experts disappear—killing the discipline through "eutrophication" rather than starvation. The IMU-backed Leiden Declaration has gathered over 3,164 signatures defending mathematics as a human endeavor. Gowers himself was shaken when ChatGPT 5.5 Pro solved doctoral-level problems and formalized his own paper in days, forcing him to redefine what mathematical research means.

title: CUDA 20年护城河一个周末崩了，Claude独自跑通AMD新GPU
content: Anthropic's AI assistant Claude successfully configured AMD's new MI355X GPU over a single weekend without human engineers writing any code, demonstrating that AI agents can bypass NVIDIA's long-established CUDA ecosystem. AMD launched ROCm.AI, a toolkit enabling agents like Claude to independently install environments, deploy models, read logs, and optimize performance using AI-readable chip documentation. AMD's Hyperloom system automates benchmarking, bottleneck detection, and kernel generation. This represents a shift from multi-year human expertise accumulation to agent-driven parallel optimization, potentially compressing the timeline for catching up to CUDA's 20-year ecosystem advantage.
